_meta.what: Event spine: Global event release dates, every known run, Clash of Wills / Dark Visions periods, and the first-run dates of quests added by later runs — one row per event AREA.
_meta.provenance: [Community] — the FFBE wiki's Update Schedule and event pages (exvius.fandom.com), reconciled by the Exvius Revival fork. The shipped tables carry no dates; nothing here is [FFBEWW].
_meta.target_client: our GL 9.0.0 client; the source fork targets 9.1.0
_meta.removal: delete this file and server/ffbe_event_spine.py — no reply path imports either; ffbe_event_spine.py --selftest enforces that
caveats: 39 areas carry no Global release date in the source (2026-11-21 archive: 'permanent' and 'other' events); they are kept with release=null rather than guessed.
A run date is a WEEK MARKER in the source's replay, not a duration: the event is shown in the week that starts on that date. Only the 67 explicit windows carry a start AND an end.
13 run dates look like typos of the release date and were skipped by the source (listed in skipped_runs); they are not in `runs`.

events_source.note: events map only; runs/windows/quest_dates carried over from `_meta.source` (the iOS fork), which is the only source that published them

quest_dates.provenance: First Global run of event quests that came after their event's first run, from the FFBE wiki's Update Schedule (Global Update History). Built by ios-server/devtools/build_event_quest_dates.py; see ios-server/research/EVENT_RUN_QUESTS.md. missions: quest -> first run; events: permanent trial events -> first run. event_archive.weekly_events serves a quest only from that date. introduced: when Global added each other always-open chamber (vortex_order.py lists the later ones last; they stay open from the start).
